evals.prompt: Here's a script from a colleague, messy_analysis.R. Restyle it to tidyverse style without changing what it does. Save the result as analysis.R. Don't run it, the data isn't here.
evals.expected_output: analysis.R restyled to the guide with zero check.R findings and behaviour unchanged
expectations: check.R (lintr, tidyverse defaults + guide extras) reports 0 lints
All library() calls come before any other code
No magrittr %>% pipe remains
No line exceeds 80 characters
No formula lambda (~ .x) remains
No single-line if/for containing return/stop/break/next
No explicit return() as a function's final expression
Data is filtered in a pipeline, not inside ggplot()'s data argument
Assignment uses <- (no top-level = assignment)
Double quotes only (no single-quoted strings)
TRUE/FALSE rather than T/F
R file contains only ASCII characters (local rule)

evals.prompt: I'm adding a function to our R package hpitools. Write count_missing(df, cols = NULL) that returns a tibble with one row per column (column, n_missing, pct_missing); if cols is given, only those columns, and throw an error with the cli package if any of them aren't in df. Give me: the R file with roxygen2 docs at R/count_missing.R, a testthat test file in the right place, a NEWS.md with the bullet for this (issue #87, contributed by @mlopez who is not a package author), and a git commit message saved to COMMIT_MSG.txt.
evals.expected_output: R/count_missing.R, tests/testthat/test-count_missing.R, NEWS.md and COMMIT_MSG.txt all following the Packages and Git chapters
expectations: Test file is tests/testthat/test-count_missing.R
roxygen title is sentence case with no trailing full stop
Every @param and @return description ends with a full stop
cli problem statement uses 'must' or "Can't", sentence case, ends with full stop
No explicit return() as the function's final expression
check.R reports 0 lints on R/ and test file
R files contain only ASCII characters (local rule)
NEWS bullet ends with (@mlopez, #87). in that order
NEWS bullet puts `count_missing()` at or near the start
NEWS in-development bullet is a single line (not wrapped)
Commit subject under 50 chars, sentence case, no trailing period
Commit has blank line after subject and contains 'Fixes #87'
